# The bytes protocol v15 puts on the wire, one fixed sample per frozen channel.
#
# Every client in players' hands reads exactly these shapes, and a reader that finds bytes left
# over is disconnected, so a line that changes here is a change that would kick everybody. Do not
# edit a line to make the test pass: give the new shape its own channel name instead. This file is
# rewritten only when PROTOCOL_VERSION is raised, which is the version that turns old clients away
# outright.
#
# Not every channel is here yet. ProtocolFrozen finds the ones that are missing and names them in
# NOT_YET_FROZEN, so what is uncovered is counted rather than assumed; a channel added from now on
# fails the test until it is recorded here or listed there.
